# test_remove_duplicates.py
import pytest

from your_module import remove_duplicates  # Replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "lst, expected",
    [
        pytest.param([1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4], id="ints_preserve_order"),
        pytest.param(["a", "b", "a", "c", "b"], ["a", "b", "c"], id="strings"),
        pytest.param([], [], id="empty_list"),
        pytest.param([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3], id="no_duplicates"),
        pytest.param([7, 7, 7], [7], id="all_duplicates"),
        pytest.param([None, "x", None, "x"], [None, "x"], id="none_and_strings"),
        pytest.param([(1, 2), (1, 2), (3, 4)], [(1, 2), (3, 4)], id="tuple_items"),
        pytest.param([1, True, 1.0, False, 0], [1, False], id="python_equality_semantics"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_returns_unique_items_in_original_order(lst, expected):
    assert remove_duplicates(lst) == expected


def test_remove_duplicates_does_not_mutate_original_list():
    lst = [3, 1, 3, 2, 1]
    original = lst.copy()

    result = remove_duplicates(lst)

    assert result == [3, 1, 2]
    assert lst == original


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "lst",
    [
        pytest.param([[1], [1]], id="list_items_are_unhashable"),
        pytest.param([{"a": 1}, {"a": 1}], id="dict_items_are_unhashable"),
        pytest.param([{1, 2}, {1, 2}], id="set_items_are_unhashable"),
        pytest.param([("ok",), ["bad"]], id="mixed_hashable_then_unhashable"),
    ],
)
def test_remove_duplicates_raises_type_error_for_unhashable_items(lst):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="unhashable type"):
        remove_duplicates(lst)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_input", [None, 42])
def test_remove_duplicates_raises_type_error_for_non_iterable_input(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        remove_duplicates(bad_input)
